description: This file defines a PHP class for managing layer styles in an invocation tag plugin, specifically for 'geocities'. It includes methods for rendering layer settings, generating layer code, and returning configuration variables.

classes.name: Plugins_oxInvocationTags_Adlayer_Layerstyles_Geocities_Invocation
classes.description: A class for managing 'geocities' layer styles in invocation tags, including UI rendering and code generation.

methods.name: placeLayerSettings
methods.description: Renders HTML for layer style settings, including alignment, close text, collapse time, and padding.

methods.name: generateLayerCode
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for embedding a layer with specified styles and parameters.

methods.name: getlayerShowVar
methods.description: Returns configuration variables for layer display options.
